title: Machine Feeders and Offbearers
description: Feed materials into or remove materials from machines or equipment that is automatic or tended by other workers.

tasks.text: Clean and maintain machinery, equipment, and work areas to ensure proper functioning and safe working conditions.
Load materials and products into machines and equipment, or onto conveyors, using hand tools and moving devices.
Transfer materials and products to and from machinery and equipment, using industrial trucks or hand trucks.
Shovel or scoop materials into containers, machines, or equipment for processing, storage, or transport.
Add chemicals, solutions, or ingredients to machines or equipment as required by the manufacturing process.
Push dual control buttons and move controls to start, stop, or adjust machinery and equipment.
Open and close gates of belt and pneumatic conveyors on machines that are fed directly from preceding machines.
Remove materials and products from machines and equipment, and place them in boxes, trucks or conveyors, using hand tools and moving devices.
Fasten, package, or stack materials and products, using hand tools and fastening equipment.
Inspect materials and products for defects, and to ensure conformance to specifications.
Record production and operational data, such as amount of materials processed.

clusters.label: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Weigh or measure materials or products to ensure conformance to specifications.
Identify and mark materials, products, and samples, following instructions.

skills.name: Operations Monitoring
skills.def: Watching gauges, dials, or other indicators to make sure a machine is working properly.

skills.name: Monitoring
skills.def: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

skills.name: Reading Comprehension
skills.def: Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work-related documents.

skills.name: Active Listening
skills.def: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

skills.name: Speaking
skills.def: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

skills.name: Troubleshooting
skills.def: Determining causes of operating errors and deciding what to do about it.

skills.name: Quality Control Analysis
skills.def: Conducting tests and inspections of products, services, or processes to evaluate quality or performance.

skills.name: Operation and Control
skills.def: Controlling operations of equipment or systems.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: Office suite software
skills.def: Software to provide word processing, spreadsheet, e-mail, presentations, or data management capabilities. Examples: Microsoft Office software.

skills.name: Electronic mail software
skills.def: Software to compose, send, or receive email. Examples: Microsoft Outlook.

skills.name: Industrial control software
skills.def: Software to control, configure, or monitor industrial processes. May communicate with intelligent electronic devices. Examples: Machine operation software.

skills.name: Time accounting software
skills.def: Software to submit or manage time accounting for human resources. Examples: Work time tracking software.
